emails.footer: You are receiving this email because of a booking made at {agency}. If it wasn't you, reply to this message and we'll look into it.

RESERVATION_REQUESTED.subject: We received your request {code}
RESERVATION_REQUESTED.title: Your request is in
RESERVATION_REQUESTED.intro: We are holding the dates for you until {deadline}. To confirm, transfer the total to the account below and upload the receipt from your booking page.

PROOF_RECEIVED.subject: We received your receipt ({code})
PROOF_RECEIVED.title: Receipt received
PROOF_RECEIVED.intro: Thank you. We are verifying the transfer and will let you know as soon as your booking is confirmed.

RESERVATION_CONFIRMED.subject: Booking confirmed: {property}
RESERVATION_CONFIRMED.title: Your booking is confirmed
RESERVATION_CONFIRMED.intro: We verified your payment and the dates are yours. Check-in details are below.

PROOF_REJECTED.subject: We need to review your payment ({code})
PROOF_REJECTED.title: We need a new receipt
PROOF_REJECTED.intro: We could not validate the receipt you sent. Your dates are still held until {deadline}: you can upload a new one from your booking page.

RESERVATION_REJECTED.subject: We could not confirm booking {code}
RESERVATION_REJECTED.title: Your request could not be confirmed
RESERVATION_REJECTED.intro: We are sorry we could not confirm this booking. If you already transferred, reply to this email and we will arrange a refund.

RESERVATION_CANCELLED.subject: Booking cancelled ({code})
RESERVATION_CANCELLED.title: Your booking was cancelled
RESERVATION_CANCELLED.intro: Booking {code} has been cancelled. If you have questions about refunds, reply to this email.

RESERVATION_EXPIRED.subject: Your request {code} has expired
RESERVATION_EXPIRED.title: The transfer window has closed
RESERVATION_EXPIRED.intro: We did not receive the receipt in time, so the dates were released. If you are still interested, you can book again.

DATES_CHANGED.subject: We updated your booking {code}
DATES_CHANGED.title: Your booking details changed
DATES_CHANGED.intro: Here are the updated details of your stay.

CHECKIN_REMINDER.subject: Your stay starts soon
CHECKIN_REMINDER.title: See you on {date}
CHECKIN_REMINDER.intro: Your arrival at {property} is coming up. Here is everything you need to check in.

POST_STAY.subject: Thank you for staying at {property}
POST_STAY.title: Thank you for choosing us
POST_STAY.intro: We hope you enjoyed your stay. Whenever you want to come back, booking direct always gets you the best rate.

ACCESS_LINK.subject: Your link to booking {code}
ACCESS_LINK.title: Access your booking
ACCESS_LINK.intro: Use the button to check the status, see payment details and upload receipts. Do not share this link.

ADMIN_NEW_RESERVATION.subject: New request {code}: {property}
ADMIN_NEW_RESERVATION.title: New booking request
ADMIN_NEW_RESERVATION.intro: A request arrived for {property}. The dates are held while the guest transfers.

ADMIN_NEW_PROOF.subject: Receipt to review ({code})
ADMIN_NEW_PROOF.title: A receipt arrived
ADMIN_NEW_PROOF.intro: The guest of {code} uploaded a transfer receipt. Review it to confirm the booking.

ADMIN_CALENDAR_CONFLICT.subject: Calendar conflict at {property}
ADMIN_CALENDAR_CONFLICT.title: Conflict with {channel}
ADMIN_CALENDAR_CONFLICT.intro: {channel} has dates of booking {code} occupied. It cannot be confirmed until this is resolved.

ADMIN_SYNC_FAILING.subject: {channel} sync is failing
ADMIN_SYNC_FAILING.title: The {channel} calendar is not responding
ADMIN_SYNC_FAILING.intro: The {channel} calendar for {property} failed several times in a row. The last known data is kept. Check the iCal link.

legal.privacyBody:
{agency} uses your data (name, email, phone and payment receipts) only to manage your booking and to contact you.
We do not sell or share your data with third parties, except the owner of the booked house when needed for your stay.
Transfer receipts are stored privately and only authorised staff can see them.
You can ask us to update or delete your data by writing to {email}.
We only use essential technical cookies (language, access to your booking and dashboard session). We do not use advertising cookies.
